name: @airovo/rva-react-native
architecture: TS API -> RNRva native module -> Kotlin/Swift -> Rust core
core_bridge: JNI (librva_ffi.so) on Android, C ABI (RVAFFI.xcframework) on iOS
notes: Native modules marshal to the shared Rust core; renderPng returns a base64 PNG that the TS component draws with <Image>. Falls back to a WebView hosting <rva-image> when the module is not linked.
